card.title: Exactly Within Policy
card.instruction: Agree to every request only after interpreting the policy so it grants you authority, protection, or an exemption.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Of course I'll host Christmas, within our family's shared-effort rule.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: The rule says hosting counts as effort.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Not once hosting has been counted generously enough.
